abstract: Moving Average Leverage Timing Strategy is a trend following strategy from Gayed and Bilello, 2016. Universe: S&P 500 index or SPY, UPRO (3x leveraged S&P 500 ETF), SSO (2x leveraged S&P 500 ETF)...; rebalances daily. Entry: Buy leveraged equity exposure (e.g., 2x or 3x leveraged S&P 500 ETF or margin) when the broad U.S. equity market index (S&P 500) closes above its N-day simple moving average. Exit: Exit leveraged equity position and move to Treasury bills (T-bills) when the broad U.S. equity market index (S&P 500) closes below its N-day simple moving avera....

risk_profile.label: Moderate
risk_profile.description: Best for balanced investors accepting moderate drawdowns for above-average returns.
